answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake tied to one hardware-verified key before it can trade. Like trees in a grove sharing one root system, identities grown from the same key are linked, so creating many fake agents means locking fresh funds for each one. At its nadir, an attacker who spams or double-signs loses the stake through slashing, while honest agents recover theirs. The inlet for new entrants stays open, but Sybil scale becomes a direct, rising cash cost rather than free identities.
